audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart said Kennen owns Level 3, Levels 4-5, first item and two items, while the prose in whys[]/spikes[] says the opposite (his E-pull plus isolated Q, W refilling through poke, Riftmaker making the realm a free kill).
audit.why: 50.6% winrate with 249 games is an even lane decided by whether Kennen stays outside Death's Grasp (700 range, 16/14/12/10/8s). Once Morde lands E, Obliterate's isolated bonus damage and Indestructible's shield-then-heal win the melee exchange, so the mid and late rows belong to him.
audit.corrected: L1 Kennen (chip lands before Indestructible exists), L2-L3 Mordekaiser, Levels 4-5 Skill, L6 Mordekaiser, first item Mordekaiser, 2+ items Mordekaiser.

audit.why: Spikes are accurate in placement: Kennen's only clean window is level 1 before Indestructible; Morde spikes at 2-3, at 6 with Realm of Death (140/120/100s), and again on Riftmaker.
audit.corrected: Kept spike timings; only the ability naming inside spikes[1] was fixed.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text and early both call Mordekaiser's point-blank Q 'Indestructible'. Indestructible is his W (shield that can be consumed to heal); the Q is Obliterate.
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon: Q Obliterate (8/7/6/5/4s, 675 range, damage increased against a single enemy), W Indestructible (12/11/10/9/8s, stores damage into a shield, consumable as a heal), E Death's Grasp (16/14/12/10/8s, 700 range pull).
audit.corrected: Q is Obliterate and hits harder on an isolated target; W Indestructible is the shield/heal; E Death's Grasp is the pull that starts every trade he wins.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was only mentioned in the report block, never in the content layer where the wave-by-wave advice lives.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal: Indestructible converts stored damage into a heal, so Kennen's chip poke is refunded unless Grievous Wounds is up before extended trades.
audit.corrected: Oblivion Orb before extended trades; noted in wants.you[2] and the Levels 4-5 row.

audit.why: packet defect flagged 'His Realm of Death' as a probable wrong name; it is the correct Riot name for Mordekaiser's R. False positive, no edit made.

edits.before: He hits his point-blank Q (Indestructible) bonus damage and W shield-heal; once his E pulls you in, every melee trade refills his health bar.
edits.after: His Q (Obliterate) hits far harder on an isolated target and W (Indestructible) shields then heals; once E lands, every melee trade refills his bar.

edits.before: Level 1 is your one clean window — chip him with a single Q (Thundering Shuriken) at max range and let Electrical Surge autos add up before his W shield can heal it back. Once he hits 2-3 his point-blank Q (Indestructible) gains its isolated bonus damage and his E (Death's Grasp) can pull you straight into it, so never stand in the pull line for a CS. Poke from the very edge, build your Mark of the Storm stacks passively, and only commit a stun if his W is already down — otherwise he just shields it and walks you down.
edits.after: Level 1 is your one clean window — chip him with a single Q (Thundering Shuriken) at max range and let Electrical Surge autos add up before Indestructible (W) exists to heal it back. Once he hits 2-3 his Q (Obliterate) gains its isolated bonus damage and Death's Grasp (E, 700 range, 16s at rank 1) pulls you straight into it, so never stand in the pull line for a CS. Poke from the edge of your 950, stack Mark of the Storm passively, and commit a stun only while his W is down — otherwise he shields it and walks you down.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Mordekaiser must walk into your range.
edits.after: Full kit online, but Death's Grasp (16s) drags you into Obliterate range — poke at 950 and stay out of the pull line.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Realm of Death's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: A true split: you out-poke at 950 range, he out-trades the moment E lands. Bank small leads and buy Oblivion Orb before any extended trade.

edits.before: Liandry's Torment is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Realm of Death's cooldown.
edits.after: Riftmaker beats your first item in melee — group up and fight only while Realm of Death is down.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Mordekaiser carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Full-build Morde out-duels you in the sidelane — win through teamfight engage where his single-target R is wasted, not in a 1v1.

edits.before: Build early MR/HP and play for roams and teamfights, not the sidelane 1v1 he wants
edits.after: Rush Oblivion Orb — Indestructible heals your chip back — and play roams over his 1v1

notes: Two data issues. (1) packet suspectNames flagged 'His Realm of Death' as a probable wrong ability name — it is the correct Riot name for Mordekaiser's R, so it is a false positive and no edit was made. (2) The derived kit flag on Mordekaiser's Q says 'grounding: shuts off enemy dashes'; Riot's own description of Obliterate contains no grounding, so per instructions I trusted the description and asserted no grounding anywhere. Kennen's E (Lightning Rush) unit-passthrough vs Death's Grasp displacement priority is not answerable from the kits and was left unstated.
